question: On the deploying tree, does the refit counter model (counter_model_v2.json in place of a19-counter-draft-v1's strengths and counters, for the counter draft and the closing pick) gain points for a Spymaster seat where it changes the seat's army, without costing a Scout seat or the human-history guard?
decisionRule: Confirmation MV3 of the refit counter model on the deploying tree (AI against AI) and its human guard MV3G. Written
before any game of MV3 or MV3G ran and before MV1's final result was read (MV1's Spymaster stratum is still running;
an interim look at 961 of its changed cases was +7.09 per changed draft, and one candidate game hit a placement bug),
Why a new test: MV1 (sha e7bee2f1) has a 0-quality-errors bar and already has one quality error: in candidate game
sim-2611252701-42-1 the v35 split re-place left no 2x2 cell for Magic Dragon, which fight start then deleted. That is a
production placement bug (it strands any large stack), fixed by the client session in server 20aea77 ("Never let an AI
seat's re-place strand a stack"). MV1 stays recorded with its quality gate failed. MV2 (registered to count only if MV1
passed) decides nothing. MV3 runs only if MV1's Spymaster strength bar holds (its lower bound per changed draft above
0); otherwise it is not run.
Tree: server 20aea77e627db252a0374c36930942dda24fab14 (origin main) with common b60b2ab6 (0.1.8, as pinned), plus
research-only files: the draft harness, the game-id override in ranked_adapter.ts and the research seam in
a19_counter_draft.ts that swaps the counter model's strengths and counters (draft_guard.ts sha256 a62027cbc869db2c...,
a19_counter_draft.ts 679c1eedf8dec6cd...). Candidate: hook model_v2 with counter_model_v2.json (07c56c687e635814...; unchanged from MV1).
MV3 populations (fresh seeds, the opponent's doctrine drawn live, both seats, production everywhere else):
S3 (primary): 1,000 drafted families from seed 2611253201, the candidate seat forced to Spymaster.
C3 (secondary): 400 drafted families from seed 2611253301, the candidate seat forced to Scout.
Stage 1 drafts production and the candidate (each host runs all of it); stage 2 plays both drafts of every changed case
(deep fit, same seeds) in 48 shards: this Mac 0-13, x3d 14-27, basenode 28-47 (the client session runs basenode).
MV3G: the owner-history games re-drafted with the hook on this tree against production's re-draft; each changed army
plays the human's replayed setup on the batteries' seeds of production's own level-4 option, paired with production's
army; life-run15k on this tree, spec or-prod; reported as MV1G.
Reported as MV1 per stratum (analyze.py: per changed case, families weighted equally, 95% from 10,000 family
resamples; the split by the opponent's doctrine as a report). Bars: S3's lower bound per changed draft above 0; C3's
lower bound at least -3; 0 quality errors in MV3 and MV3G; MV3G's estimate at least -2 per game. All met makes the
refit model (a19-counter-draft-v2: counter_model_v2.json in place of v1 for the counter draft and the closing pick) an
adoption candidate for every default AI seat and Premium draft advice.

screen.note: MV1's quality gate failed (one placement-bug game, fixed in server 20aea77); MV1 stays recorded as failed and MV3 decides.
